title: Purified Water systems: pretreatment, RO, DI/EDI | Aquemi
meta: A modular Purified Water package in polypropylene with PVC pretreatment, designed in Ontario to meet USP <645> and <643>. For drug, device, hospital, laboratory, personal care and process plants. No WFI, pure steam or stainless steel.
headline: Modular Purified Water systems, from pretreatment to point of use
lead: For makers of drugs, natural health products and devices; for hospitals, labs, personal care and process plants. One polypropylene Purified Water package, designed in Ontario. No Water for Injection, pure steam or stainless steel systems.
primary_cta_intent: Not sure yet: talk to an engineer

facts.l: Skids tested with water · at FAT

blocks.intro: One package makes Purified Water (PW) for your products and final rinses, from drinking water to the point of use.

items.d: Polyvinyl chloride (PVC) pretreatment protects the reverse osmosis (RO) membranes from chlorine, chloramine and particles.
RO and deionization on a polypropylene (PP) skid, designed to meet the USP conductivity and organic carbon limits.
PP tank and loop: turbulent flow at peak demand, sanitized by [PP loop sanitization method].
Online total organic carbon (TOC) and conductivity, with audit trails.

blocks.h: Same package, different limits by industry

items.d: In oral liquids, creams, coatings and final equipment rinses. Natural health products (GUI-0158): potable minimum, PW where your specification or monograph calls for it.
In every client's product, from one system: the stricter of USP and Ph. Eur. on each attribute, plus each client's limits.
The final rinse of components before packaging, with the grade worked back from your device limits.
Washer-disinfector final rinse in sterile processing, and reagent water for laboratories. Hospitals name critical water (ST108:2023); labs name ASTM D1193-24 Type II or III.
Ingredient water in creams, lotions and shampoos, and the final rinse of fillers. Cosmetics follow your written spec; over-the-counter drug lines need PW.
Proofing and ingredient water, parts and electronics rinse, electrolyser feed and boiler make-up. Your recipe, process or equipment maker sets the limit.

blocks.h: From order to water in use

items.d: We turn your user requirement specification (URS) into a design you approve before anything is built.
We build the PP skids and record each joint.
A factory acceptance test (FAT) with water, to a protocol your quality unit approves.
Site acceptance tests on your utilities, then installation and operational qualification (IQ/OQ) to protocols your quality unit approves.
After performance qualification (PQ) phase 1, your quality unit releases the water. The project plan shows each stage's length, notice and who holds it.
PQ support through 12 months of data, then service and spare parts.

blocks.intro: Order to water in use: [order to water in use, weeks]. Not under good manufacturing practice (GMP)? The same stages apply, with commissioning and an acceptance test against your specification in place of qualification.

items.d: Like-for-like parts, or the change goes through your change control first.
Service plans from [lowest plan price, CAD per year], plus consumables and energy.
A signed report after each visit, for your quality records.

items.q: Who stands behind the system after handover?
items.a: Your design engineer stays your contact [confirm]. Our team knows pharmaceutical water, controls and modular fabrication. We design and fabricate the package; [membranes and instruments bought from their makers]. You keep as-built drawings, joint records, FAT and qualification reports. Audit our quality system on [on-site audit notice, working days] notice. Witness your FAT with [FAT witness notice, working days] notice.

items.q: Do you supply WFI or pure steam?
items.a: No: we supply a Purified Water (PW) package in polypropylene, not Water for Injection (WFI), pure steam or stainless steel.

items.q: Do you work outside pharmaceutical manufacturing?
items.a: Yes. Hospitals, laboratories, personal care, food, beverage and industrial plants get the same package. It is configured to the limit their standard or process sets. A hot-held loop or steam needs a polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) or stainless loop [whether we quote PVDF].

items.q: We have no URS yet. Is it too early to ask?
items.a: No. Ask for a water scope review and tell us what you make. In [scope review turnaround, working days] we return the grade each step needs, the package and its qualification scope. Cost: [scope review cost or free]. [review obligation and use in your tender]
